answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 11774 Country: India Title: Using spoon for drinking liquid food is correct or against SUNNAT? Question: Using spoon for drinking liquid food is correct or against SUNNAT? Answer ID: 11774 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 500/500=M/1430) Using spoon is lawful for eating, but it is sunnah to eat by hand. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
